text:
morgan: heads up — deploybot flagged a repeat artifact-verify flake on the release job, holding the cut. 

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.03.23 job artifact-verify failed (checksum mismatch) — holding promotion. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1725000000 

samir: copy. which job exactly? full log snip?
morgan: build-frontend-prod step. quick log: 
```
ERROR: artifact verify failed for bundle-frontend.tgz
expected sha256: e3b0c44298fc...
actual   sha256: e3b0c44298fd...
Verification: FAILED (transient?)
```

jen: ugh that's the same mismatch we saw earlier this week on the EU runner. could be S3 multipart reassembly flake or runner cache corruption.
ricardo: can we just pin to last-good image for the change window and promote? pros: unblock PMs. cons: risks shipping binary drift.
samir: pinning is safest if we ensure a rollback path. do we have last-good artifact digest?
morgan: last-good: bundle-frontend.tgz@sha256:ab12cd34 — verified on 1724960000. I can pin and update release notes + call it out in postmortem.
ops-oncall: what about rerunning the job? a rerun would re-hydrate caches and might pass; but rerun will take ~20mins and may push us past the change window.
jen: change window closes in 35m. rerun + manual promote = risky. pin now, follow up with full rerun in off-window and root-cause.
ricardo: rollout plan if we pin: 1) pin artifact to ab12cd34, 2) canary in prod (2% for 15m), 3) metrics/errs watch, 4) full promote if green. fallback: immediate rollback to previous tag if errors >0.5% user impact.
samir: agree. add a note to release notes: "Pinned frontend artifact due to CI artifact-verify flake; full verify & rerun scheduled post-release."
morgan: i'll do the pin and kick the canary. doing: 
```
# pin artifact
deploybot pin --release release/2026.03.23 --component frontend --digest ab12cd34
deploybot promote --release release/2026.03.23 --mode canary --percent 2
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned frontend to ab12cd34; canary started 2% at 1725000145.
ops-oncall: monitoring dashboards: latency/5xx/ctr looking baseline for first 5m. will alert if anomalies.
jen: i'll update the release notes and send a short blurb to #customer-facing.
ricardo: file a follow-up ticket to investigate runner cache / S3 reassembly and include runner-ids: eu-runner-7, s3-mpu-03.
morgan: filed: ENG-4921. blocking reason, logs attached.
samir: decision summary: pin + canary now to meet change window; full rerun + deep debug after window. ack from everyone?
jen: :thumbsup:
ricardo: ack
ops-oncall: ack
samir: resolving thread — unhold manual once canary stable.
morgan: canary passed 15m check, promoting to 100% now. promote command run at 1725000358.
deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1725000360. release cut unblocked.
